symptoms: Irregular skeletonized feeding holes on leafy greens
Young seedlings severed at ground level during nighttime feeding
Larvae hiding in soil crevices at base of crop during daytime

treatment_protocol.organic: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) bio-insecticide application or neem seed kernel extract
treatment_protocol.chemical: Spinetoram or Indoxacarb spray targeting early larval instars
treatment_protocol.cultural_prevention: Deep plowing before planting to expose pupae to solar radiation and birds, light traps
